DEWARIM_MAP.Title: Map Painter
DEWARIM_MAP.AddRoot: Add a folder to the palette
DEWARIM_MAP.AddRootHint: A folder in user data (assets/props, assets/textures/dungeon) or of Foundry (icons/environment).
DEWARIM_MAP.RemoveRoot: Remove this folder from the palette
DEWARIM_MAP.Missing: This folder does not exist yet. Put images there with the File Commander or by uploading.
DEWARIM_MAP.PickHint: Pick an image, then click or drag on the canvas.
DEWARIM_MAP.ModeFloorHint: The cells become floor: you walk on it and you see across it. On a world filled with material a stroke takes the material away where it draws - a floor means there is floor there.
DEWARIM_MAP.ModeWallHint: The cells become solid wall: it blocks sight, light, sound and movement, and there is no floor under it. On a world filled with material the wall takes the material's place.
DEWARIM_MAP.ModePropHint: Something lying on the floor - a rug, a pile of rocks, a chest. It lies above the floor and replaces nothing, so whatever it does not cover still shows.
DEWARIM_MAP.AxisBrushHint: Paints the texture into the cells: it repeats every few cells, covers only what you drag over, and is no tile you could click or move. For ground, water, a cave floor - the surface itself. Floor and wall only, square grids only.
DEWARIM_MAP.AxisStampHint: Puts the image down whole, as one tile in the size you choose: one per click, a row of them along a drag, turned or mirrored as you like. For a door, a chest, a tree - or for a floor piece that is drawn as a picture rather than as a repeating texture.
DEWARIM_MAP.PropStampOnly: Props are placed one at a time, so there is no brush for them.
DEWARIM_MAP.HelpSlot: A cell has one slot for floor or wall, and above it any number of props. Floor and wall share that slot and replace each other, so a stroke of either deletes the painter's own floors and walls where it draws - undo brings them back. A prop lies above and replaces nothing, which is why what it does not cover still shows.
DEWARIM_MAP.BrushHint: Pick a texture, then paint the cells it covers.
DEWARIM_MAP.BrushKeys: Drag paints · Ctrl+drag fills a rectangle · Alt+drag makes it solid again
DEWARIM_MAP.OpenOnlyHint: Paint with no texture: the cells are opened and the floor below stays as it is - what shows is a floor painted earlier, or the scene's background.
DEWARIM_MAP.FillWorldHint: Covers the whole scene with the selected image as solid material, or with black rock when nothing is picked. Floors are then painted into it.
DEWARIM_MAP.ChangeMaterialHint: The whole world is filled with the selected image instead; the floors already open stay open.
DEWARIM_MAP.RepeatHint: How many grid cells one copy of the texture covers before it repeats.
DEWARIM_MAP.PaintSquareOnly: The brush paints square grids only.
DEWARIM_MAP.BlocksHint: This prop gets walls around it, so it blocks sight, light, sound and movement - a pillar, a pile of rocks. It belongs to the stroke, not to the image, and it is a prop all the same: the floor under it stays.
DEWARIM_MAP.SlotReplaced: {count} floor or wall tiles replaced - a cell has one floor, and this stroke says what it is. Undo brings them back.
DEWARIM_MAP.SlotReplacedOne: One floor or wall tile replaced - a cell has one floor, and this stroke says what it is. Undo brings it back.
DEWARIM_MAP.RockBlocks: Rock blocks view (walls along the edges)
DEWARIM_MAP.RemoveRockConfirm: Remove the rock layer of this scene - its tiles, its walls and everything carved? This cannot be undone.
DEWARIM_MAP.CleanupConfirm: Delete {count} tiles that another tile hides completely - same place, same image, same everything? Ctrl+Z brings them back. {covered} more are covered by a different image and are left alone: an image with transparent parts shows what is below it.
DEWARIM_MAP.CleanupNone: No tile is hidden by an identical one. {covered} are covered by a different image, which may well be the point.
DEWARIM_MAP.ResetHint: Empties this scene for a test: every tile, every wall, the painted floor and the material. Undo puts it back.
DEWARIM_MAP.ResetConfirm: Empty this scene - {tiles} tiles, {walls} walls, the painted floor and the material? For testing. Nothing else on the scene is touched (tokens, lights, notes), and Undo reset puts all of it back.
DEWARIM_MAP.ResetDone: Scene emptied: {tiles} tiles and {walls} walls removed. Undo reset puts them back.
DEWARIM_MAP.ResetNothing: Nothing to reset: no tiles, no walls, no floor, no material.
DEWARIM_MAP.SearchDeep: Stopped after {folders} folders - narrow the search.
DEWARIM_MAP.UploadFailed: The painted image {name} could not be saved - see the error above.
